ext.minecraft_log_uploader.page.title: Minecraft Log Uploader
ext.minecraft_log_uploader.page.subtitle: Inspect server logs, and publish one to mclo.gs when you need to share it.
ext.minecraft_log_uploader.upload.confir: This sends the contents of {file} to mclo.gs, a third-party paste service outside this panel. Anyone with the returned link can read it. Logs often contain IP addresses, usernames and occasionally credentials — obvious tokens are stripped first, but that is best-effort, not a guarantee. Only the last 10 MiB is sent if the file is larger.
ext.minecraft_log_uploader.upload.trunca: The file was larger than 10 MiB, so only its last 10 MiB was published.
ext.minecraft_log_uploader.pane.truncate: File is large — showing the last 512 KB. Upload publishes the last 10 MiB.
ext.minecraft_log_uploader.pane.loadFail: Could not load this log file.
ext.minecraft_log_uploader.pane.noMatche: No lines match the current filter.
